output.explanation: Seller NIG-US line NIG-US:4471155 invoiced a management fee of USD 71,000 (INV-US-100393). output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should book the USD 14,200 withheld tax as a WHT payable to the authority and gross up the IC payable to USD 71,000, while NIG-US records the WHT receivable or credit and obtains the WHT certificate.
